WHEREAS, THE CLERK FOR THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA, HAS PREPARED AND SUBMITTED TO THE GOVERNING AUTHORITY, A BUDGET AMENDMENT PROPOSAL FOR THE FISCAL YEAR BEGINNING JULY 1, 2024 AND ENDING JUNE 30, 2025; AND

WHEREAS, THE TOWN COUNCIL OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA HAS STUDIED AND REVISED THE PROPOSED BUDGET, AND DOES HEREBY CONSIDER IN THE BEST INTEREST OF THE TOWN OF CLERMONT TO APPROVE THE BUDGET AMENDMENT AS PROPSOSED. THE PROPOSED BUDGET AMENDMENT REQUIRES NO OVERALL INCREASE IN THE TOWN’S BUDGET, ONLY A RECLASSIFICATION OF ALREADY APPROVED TOTAL BETWEEN DEPARTMENTS.

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE TOWN COUNCIL FOR THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA, DULY ASSEMBLED AND BY UNANIMOUS VOTE THEREOF, THAT THE BUDGET AMENDMENT ATTACHED HERETO AND MADE A PART HEREOF FOR THE YEAR BEGINNING JULY 1, 2024 AND ENDING JUNE 30, 2025.

_Aames Nix, Mayor
